prompt:
Redesign IMAGE1's blue male guard toward the CHINESE GIANT-SHIELD HEAVY-ARMOR FEEL demonstrated by IMAGE2.
Image1 supplies the established BLUE/NAVY/STEEL palette, male face/black hair with ivory temple streak, beard, compact cast proportions, left-facing standing pose and shield-plus-halberd role.
Image2 supplies the powerful MASS DISTRIBUTION: huge upper torso, thick neck/traps, enormous protective shoulder/forearm equipment, weight-bearing legs and an intimidating genuinely heavy shield. Do not copy its bald head, gray moustache, bare chest/tattoos, fur clutter, gray background, exact costume or round shield. User's previous NON-ROUND, BILATERALLY SYMMETRIC and SIMPLIFIED shield requirement remains active.

MAIN GOAL: A CHINESE FANTASY HEAVY DEFENDER WITH GIANT SHIELD, not a smooth generic western blue knight.
Compact roughly FOUR actual head heights crown-to-sole excluding hair knot/weapon. Greatly substantial broad back/chest/neck and strong arms, powerful full torso rather than tiny waist; visibly heavier than image1 while anatomically grounded. Keep existing mature square-jawed male identity and restrained beard, confident calm protective face. Skin warm and organic, no realistic muscle detail or face facet mosaic.

CHINESE ARMOR DESIGN:
Build a recognizable Chinese collar/armor relationship: ivory crossover inner collar emerging from a dark navy padded standing neck guard.
A MASSIVE asymmetrical SHOULDER SWALLOW-GUARD (吞肩) on the exposed screen-left shoulder, inspired by a stylized guardian beast/cloud jaw: ONLY TWO or THREE large interlocking blue-and-steel curved planes, one simple broad jaw-like opening/crest. No detailed animal face, eyes/teeth/fur rendering, spikes everywhere or a ring emblem. Big graphic armor shape rather than many small decorations.
Broad navy/cobalt chest cuirass with one large overlapping horizontal plated section and a strong upper rim. Lower armor uses two broad Chinese lamellar-inspired apron plates over thick cloth, each divided into only TWO broad horizontal bands rather than hundreds of tiny scales. A wide stable waist sash with one simple buckle.
Enormous short sturdy forearm bracers and large articulated knee/shin guards made from a few curved overlapping shells. Strong boots, thick legs with moderate knee flex. Sparse ivory cloth and a small dull-gold fastener only; blue is clearly dominant.
The silhouette combines a wide stable upper body, one huge shoulder, thick braced arms, giant shield and two planted legs. No billowing cape or many thin tails.

GIANT SHIELD:
Replace the thin pointed heater-like shield with a THICK CHINESE DOOR-SLAB/TOWER SHIELD: almost rectangular, slightly wider at upper shoulders, matching clipped/chamfered top corners, equal parallel/slightly tapering long sides and a broad lower edge with clipped bottom corners. NON-ROUND, NOT a medieval pointed kite. Physical design perfectly LEFT-RIGHT SYMMETRIC about vertical centerline.
Shield about shoulder-to-upper-ankle height, carried on near arm screen-right, offset enough to show face, chest center and both boots. Clear 10–15 percent thickness along one side, real giant weight. Front is ONE broad cobalt panel with TWO broad navy/blue value faces divided by a very shallow central ridge; one thick quiet steel rim. A SINGLE large symmetric shallow inverted-U/cloud-arch structural band near top may suggest Chinese gate architecture. No animal emblem, central gem, medallion, rows of studs, tiny patterns or stacked border rings. Strong few-region graphic design.
Show enough side thickness and shield-arm bracing to feel like a real heavy barricade, not a flat blue UI icon.

HALBERD / STANCE:
Keep one simple upright straight-shaft Chinese halberd at screen-left, coherent spearpoint and one side crescent. Correct grip and full weapon in frame; do not add weapons.
Front THREE-QUARTER SCREEN LEFT face/chest/hips/feet. Stable protective stance, shoulders slightly forward under weight, one leg carries more weight, comfortable planted foot gap. Not a deep squat, running, jumping or crossed knees. Strong but compact, whole figure and gear remain visible.

RENDER:
Project gem-icon clean large-volume style: bold dark outer contours, sparse inner lines, 2–3 broad matte light/shadow groups per material. Make armor massive through shapes and overlap, not through fine texture, scratched metal, glitter or noisy triangular facets. Preserve blue/navy/steel palette and clear silhouette. One full character, square warm ivory plain background, generous margin around all gear/feet, no text, scene, floor shadow, frame or extra characters.
purpose: Translate user's mass/armor reference into a blue Chinese giant-shield heavy guard with a symmetric simplified non-round tower shield.
visual_review: Heavier shoulder/arm/leg mass, large curved Chinese-inspired shoulder shell, wide segmented waist armor and thick symmetric chamfered tower shield; blue palette and halberd retained.
